headline: IDX Reveals Findings on Issuers in Warrant Manipulation Case
summary: Indonesia's stock exchange disclosed findings concerning listed issuers in a warrant trading manipulation case. Three suspects are detained.
why: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) oversees listings and trading in Indonesia, and manipulation cases affect market integrity and investor confidence.
original_headline: BEI Ungkap Temuan soal Emiten di Kasus Manipulasi Waran
